env.app: OPENAI_API_KEY= THESYS_API_KEY= AETHER_TEST_USER_DATA=$SCR/older/ud bun run dev --remoteDebuggingPort 9351 (this build, before the planner fix)

actions.eval: (async () => { const s = await import("/state/index.ts"); const w = s.useHistoryStore.getState().world; return w.status === "ready" ? { head: w.value.sequenced.head.n, migrated: w.value.ensured?.migrated, added: w.value.ensured?.added, adoptedFrom: w.value.ensured?.adoptedFrom, skipped: w.value.ensured?.skipped?.map(s => s.what + " " + s.key), adjusted: w.value.ensured?.adjusted } : w })()
